Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & packaging request: OrthoCare Pro pilot

Markus,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team at NovaOrtho is excited about Redwood's latency and private deployment options. We have an internal pilot budget but need a deeper package concession to make the numbers work. Key asks: 

- 45% off list for the OrthoCare Pro SKU for a 12-month committed pilot (estimated spend $240k).
- Ability to remove the enterprise onboarding bundle (we'll self-manage some workstreams).
- VPC/private deployment option and standard SOC2 evidence.

Best,
Leah Carter

NovaOrtho

Subject: RE: Fwd: Pricing & packaging request: OrthoCare Pro pilot

Markus — reviewed the ask and ran a preliminary margin model (attached). Quick summary: 

- 45% off list for 12 months would put the pilot below our sustainable unit margin given the VPC/onboarding lift.
- We can make a one-time carve-out but we need to protect revenue and CLTV: proposed concession = 30% off list for a 12-month pilot + a 6-month post-pilot conversion commitment (or an 18-month total commitment).
- Alternative path: 40% off for 12 months if NovaOrtho agrees to a $100k non-refundable onboarding fee and a minimum monthly usage floor (50% of forecast) with quarterly true-ups.

Recommended approval path: anything >30% needs VP/CFO sign-off. If we go the 40%+ route, legal needs explicit payment terms and a shortened refund window.

Action items: 
- Kimberly, can you confirm whether finance will entertain the 40% with the onboarding fee / floor?
- Karthik, build the two packaging SKUs (30% with 18-month commit; 40% + onboarding fee + floor) and show expected ARR conversion scenarios.

Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Programs
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: margin_analysis.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pricing & packaging request: OrthoCare Pro pilot

Thanks for the analysis — notable points below.

- Finance position: we can authorize up to a 30% pilot concession at the SD-Head level. Anything above 30% requires CFO sign-off and a documented revenue protection mechanism (usage floor or non-refundable onboarding).
- For the 40% path the onboarding fee is acceptable, but must be contractually non-refundable and tied to milestone deliverables. Payment terms should be net-30 with an accelerated clause if usage drops below floor three months in a row.
- Legal redlines (on my desk): tighten the indemnity and add an audit clause for usage reporting.

If sales wants to pursue 40% + fee, route an exec memo to the CFO with: margin impact, conversion forecast, recommended guardrails, and the signed procurement note. I can endorse to the CFO once that memo is in place.

Kimberly Park
Interim VP Finance (acting CFO)
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Pricing & packaging request: OrthoCare Pro pilot

Leah — thanks for the patience. We reviewed internally and can move forward with two options so you have flexibility: 

Option A (standard guardrails): 30% off list for a 12-month pilot + commitment to convert for an additional 6 months (18-month total). No onboarding waiver.

Option B (accelerated concession): 40% off list for 12 months if NovaOrtho agrees to a $100k non-refundable onboarding fee and a minimum monthly usage floor (50% of forecast) with quarterly true-ups. Payment terms net-30; Redwood will provide SOC2 evidence and a private VPC deployment window aligned to the onboarding milestones.

We're ready to present both to your procurement team. If you'd like Option B we need an exec sign-off from our CFO (process is quick if you can confirm the onboarding fee and floor). Can we schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize?

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
